packages.summary_en: Exact rational/algebraic computation: symbolic polynomials, Q-linear algebra, algebraic numbers, Jordan theory, spectral identities, and certified Jacobi intervals.
packages.summary_zh: 精確有理／代數計算：符號多項式、Q 線性代數、代數數、Jordan 理論、譜恆等與認證 Jacobi 區間。

packages.summary_en: The mutually recursive cubical dependent kernel, plus the still-logical foundation/finite/numeric/model/frontend components that are not yet separate MoonBit packages.
packages.summary_zh: 互相遞迴的立方依賴核心，以及尚未拆成實體 MoonBit 套件的 foundation／finite／numeric／model／frontend 邏輯元件。

packages.summary_en: Executable theorem-registry report.
packages.summary_zh: 印出定理登記表的執行入口。

packages.summary_en: Finite symmetry: graph canonical forms, automorphism groups, finite categories, presheaves, G-sets and executable certificates.
packages.summary_zh: 有限對稱：圖規範形、自同構群、有限範疇、預層、G-集與可執行證書。

packages.summary_en: Executable finite-symmetry demonstration.
packages.summary_zh: 有限對稱展示執行入口。

packages.summary_en: Finite-symmetry benchmark executable.
packages.summary_zh: 有限對稱 Benchmark 執行入口。

packages.summary_en: Semiring, idempotent/star/tropical semiring and monoid traits, concrete carrier types, law checkers and operation counters.
packages.summary_zh: 半環、冪等／星閉／熱帶半環與么半群 traits、具體載體、定律檢察器與運算計數。

packages.summary_en: Generic dense/CSR matrices over semiring carriers, blocked kernels and Kleene-star closures.
packages.summary_zh: 半環係數泛型稠密／CSR 矩陣、分塊核與 Kleene 星閉包。

packages.summary_en: Monoid scans and aggregated data structures.
packages.summary_zh: 么半群掃描與聚合資料結構。

packages.summary_en: Directed weighted CSR graphs and algebraic path algorithms.
packages.summary_zh: 有向加權 CSR 圖與代數路徑演算法。

packages.summary_en: Spline interpolation and banded linear solvers.
packages.summary_zh: 樣條插值與帶狀線性求解。

packages.summary_en: Tropical polynomials, Newton polygons, dual subdivisions and assignments.
packages.summary_zh: 熱帶多項式、Newton 多邊形、對偶細分與指派。

packages.summary_en: Regular-expression/DFA and free idempotent-semiring normal forms.
packages.summary_zh: 正則表達式／DFA 與自由冪等半環正規形。

packages.summary_en: Set-valued matrices, free categories on DAGs and Maslov dequantization.
packages.summary_zh: 集合值矩陣、DAG 自由範疇與 Maslov 去量子化。

packages.summary_en: Algebraic path problems with independent implementation arbitration.
packages.summary_zh: 代數路徑問題與多實作仲裁。

packages.summary_en: Semiring belief propagation on factor graphs.
packages.summary_zh: 因子圖上的半環信念傳播。

packages.summary_en: GCRA rate-limiting application package.
packages.summary_zh: GCRA 限流應用套件。

packages.summary_en: Edge-list parsing and synthetic graph input generation.
packages.summary_zh: 邊表剖析與合成圖輸入生成。

packages.summary_en: Timing, cache and memory-hierarchy measurement models.
packages.summary_zh: 時間、快取與記憶階層量測模型。

packages.summary_en: Portable backend seam for chunked aggregation and shard I/O.
packages.summary_zh: 分塊聚合與分片 I/O 的可移植後端接縫。

packages.summary_en: Compiled semiring teaching examples.
packages.summary_zh: 可編譯的半環教學範例。

packages.summary_en: The single one-way five-member federation core, expanded in place from the original three-pillar bridge: federation registry, certificates, and cross-member finite category/group/G-set, polynomial/matrix, Boolean/topology/Spec, dynamics/homology, circle and STLC commuting diagrams.
packages.summary_zh: 單一的單向五成員聯邦核心，由原三支柱橋就地擴張：聯邦註冊表與證書，以及有限範疇／群／G-集、多項式／矩陣、布林／拓撲／譜、動力系統／同調、圓周與 STLC 的跨成員可交換圖表。

packages.summary_en: Executable five-member federation showcase: member registry, all bridge certificates and the original graph-symmetry/projector demonstration.
packages.summary_zh: 五成員聯邦展示執行入口：成員註冊表、全部橋證書及原圖對稱／投影算子展示。

packages.summary_en: Native-only moonbitlang/async host backend for the portable semiring parallel seam.
packages.summary_zh: 可移植半環平行接縫的 native-only moonbitlang/async 主機後端。

packages.summary_en: Native-only measured semiring report generator. The ~66-second report is a slow gate, never a fast/default gate.
packages.summary_zh: native-only 半環量測報告產生器；約 66 秒的報告只作慢閘門，永不進快速／預設閘門。

packages.summary_en: Modular integer arithmetic, deterministic primality, factorization, CRT and elementary number theory for the finalg pillar.
packages.summary_zh: finalg 支柱的模整數算術、確定性素性、因數分解、CRT 與初等數論。

packages.summary_en: Dense matrices, RREF, rank, nullspaces and linear solvers over prime fields.
packages.summary_zh: 素域上的稠密矩陣、RREF、秩、零空間與線性求解。

packages.summary_en: Finite-field rings and multivariate polynomials, Groebner bases, ideals and integer/finite-field normal forms.
packages.summary_zh: 有限域環與多變量多項式、Gröbner 基、理想與整數／有限域正規範形。

packages.summary_en: Finite algebras presented by structure constants, ideals, radicals, localization and finite-ring structure.
packages.summary_zh: 以結構常數呈現的有限代數、理想、根、局部化與有限環結構。

packages.summary_en: Finite modules, duals, homological/projective constructions, inverse systems and sheaf-like gluing.
packages.summary_zh: 有限模、對偶、同調／射影構造、逆向系統與層式黏合。

packages.summary_en: Finite algebraic geometry: varieties, rational points and dimension/ideal computations.
packages.summary_zh: 有限代數幾何：簇、有理點與維數／理想計算。

packages.summary_en: Finite affine schemes: spectra, stalks/local data and finite gluing constructions.
packages.summary_zh: 有限仿射概形：譜、莖／局部資料與有限黏合構造。

packages.summary_en: Finite computational HoTT: equivalences, HIT circle/quotients, truncation levels and rewriting models.
packages.summary_zh: 有限計算 HoTT：等價、HIT 圓／商、截斷層級與重寫模型。

packages.summary_en: Closure-dictionary categories/groupoids, delooping, free path categories, partition groupoids and Grothendieck classes.
packages.summary_zh: 閉包字典範疇／群胚、去圈、自由路徑範疇、分割群胚與 Grothendieck 類。

packages.summary_en: Static interface-port and migration reporting utilities over MoonBit-like signatures.
packages.summary_zh: 以 MoonBit 式簽名為對象的靜態接口移植與遷移報告工具。

packages.summary_en: Deterministic random-generation and fixture utilities used by finalg black-box/white-box tests.
packages.summary_zh: 供 finalg 黑箱／白箱測試使用的確定性隨機生成與 fixture 工具。

packages.summary_en: Proof-enabled elementary integer arithmetic with contracted division, powers and modular exponentiation.
packages.summary_zh: 啟用 proof 的初等整數算術：合約式除法、冪次與模冪。

packages.summary_en: A large single-package library of finite category theory, higher algebra, homological algebra, canonical forms and computational type theory.
packages.summary_zh: 大型單一套件函式庫：有限範疇論、高維代數、同調代數、規範形式與計算型別論。

packages.summary_en: Executable catmath entry point split from the upstream library/executable package.
packages.summary_zh: 由上游函式庫／執行檔同包拆出的 catmath 執行入口。

components.summary_en: De Morgan dimensions, face formulas, ROBDDs and DAG BDD decisions.
components.summary_zh: De Morgan 維度、面公式、ROBDD 與 DAG BDD 判定。

components.summary_en: Floating complex linear algebra, Hermitian projectors, vector partial systems and affine cubes with pruning.
components.summary_zh: 浮點複線性代數、Hermitian 投影、向量偏系統與剪枝仿射立方體。

components.summary_en: A physically separate exact-algebra MoonBit package: BigInt rationals, complete Q-factorization, real/complex root isolation, splitting fields, radical denesting, multiquadratic tower fields and arbitrary-precision Jacobi intervals.
components.summary_zh: 已實體拆出的精確代數 MoonBit 套件：BigInt 有理數、Q 上完整因式分解、實／複根隔離、分裂域、根式去巢、多二次塔體與任意精度 Jacobi 區間。

components.summary_en: Simply typed NbE/HOAS (including narrow cross-package STLC constructors for the federation bridge) and the finite Bool/Unit/product universe with wiring equivalences, ua, PathP, Glue and J.
components.summary_zh: 簡單型別 NbE／HOAS，以及 Bool／Unit／積有限宇宙的 wiring 等價、ua、PathP、Glue 與 J。

components.summary_en: One compilation SCC by design: dependent NbE, AST Kan operations, first-class equivalences/Glue, checked lines, DTerm transforms, inductive/HIT schema generation, universe-polymorphic and simultaneous declarations call each other.
components.summary_zh: 設計上同一個編譯 SCC：依賴 NbE、AST Kan、一等 Equiv／Glue、受檢查線、DTerm 轉換、歸納／HIT schema 生成、宇宙多態與同時宣告互相呼叫。

components.summary_en: Host-level dependent type lines (DLine) and embeddings of simple/finite types.
components.summary_zh: 宿主層依賴型別線 DLine，以及簡單／有限型別的嵌入。

components.summary_en: Cross-domain categorical/Hermitian models: syntactic categories, general finite/subspace Glue composition, exact numeric shadows and certified algebra over general algebraic extensions.
components.summary_zh: 跨域範疇／Hermitian 模型：句法範疇、有限／子空間 Glue comp、精確數值影子與一般代數擴張上的認證代數。

components.summary_en: Surface elaboration and separate compilation: extended pattern HOU, parameterized modules, compiled interfaces, linking and incremental cache, interned-DAG binary snapshots, and artifact repositories with an append-only integrity chain. Nothing in the kernel may depend back on this layer.
components.summary_zh: 表面闡釋與分離編譯：擴展 pattern HOU、參數化模組、已編譯介面、連結與增量快取、intern DAG 二進位快照，以及帶 append-only 完整性鏈的工件儲存庫。核心不得反向依賴此層。

components.summary_en: High-level cubical constructions and algorithms: spheres and homotopy representatives, propositional truncation, adjoint-equivalence data, transport/path algebra, path-to-equivalence and computational univalence certificates.
components.summary_zh: 高層立方構造與演算法：球面與同倫代表元、命題截斷、adjoint equivalence 資料、transport／路徑代數、path-to-equivalence 與計算性 univalence 證書。

components.summary_en: Executable law bundles. They may observe lower layers but no production component may depend on them except the registry.
components.summary_zh: 可執行律束。可以觀察低層，但除 registry 外，生產元件不得依賴它們。
